I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on **November 3, 2025**.

- **Moss's digest:** The Coastal digest from Sun 11/2 says "Account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03."
- **Bettina's recap:** Her own Dec 8 recap note also calls Nov 3 the official handoff.
- **Day-to-day caveat:** That same note says she kept running PHL day to day through Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 22 if the coverage tracker needs the date coverage actually moved.
